conventions: One entry per code and side. Side A is the front, side B the back of a double-sided card; a shadow effect is a line of side A.
lines are the ability text of the text box in print order, one ability per line: no title, traits, stats, flavor text, or Victory line. Keyword lines (Surge., Hide 2.) stay.
Icons are written as the words Hall of Beorn uses (Willpower, Attack, Defense, Threat, Lore, Fellowship). Apostrophes are straight.
A printed typo is written corrected in lines, and the printed wording is kept under misprints.
inert lists line numbers that need no effect record, with the reason. A line that is only keywords the engine reads is owned by the keyword.
The heading icons are written Sun (on-course), Cloud, Rain and Storm (the worst heading); a quest stage's card side B is its stage B.

sailingSuccess is the number of Sailing success symbols (a ship's wheel) the card prints in the bottom left corner of its text box (dcce.sailing-tests), 0 when it prints none; it is recorded for every card the encounter deck can hold. A line that names the symbol writes it Sailing success symbol.
